references.text: Describes the sons of Merari and their responsibilities in the tabernacle, which form the basis for the counting in 4:45
Contains the instructions for counting the sons of Merari, the results of which are summarized in verse 45
Parallel wording regarding the counting of the sons of Kohath, also carried out by Moses and Aaron at the Lord's command
Parallel wording regarding the counting of the sons of Gershon, also carried out by Moses and Aaron at the Lord's command
Shows the pattern where the Israelites did everything just as the Lord had commanded Moses
Later census of the Levites, including the clan of Merari
Mentions Merari as one of the sons of Levi in the genealogy
